title: 木材环保认证（FSC/E0/甲醛）
titleEn: Wood Eco Certification: FSC / E0 / Formaldehyde

intro.background: 欧洲客户对木材环保极其敏感。核心认证：FSC（森林可持续）、PEFC、E0/E1（甲醛释放等级）、CARB P2（美国加州标准）。木材本身+板材+胶水+涂料，每一层都要环保。
intro.desc: 掌握木材环保认证和英语沟通。

oneLiner.en: European buyers will ask about FSC and formaldehyde levels before they ask about price.
oneLiner.cn: 欧洲客户问FSC和甲醛水平比问价格还早。

vocab.ex: FSC stands for Forest Stewardship Council.
Formaldehyde must be below E0 level.
CARB P2 is the California standard.

vocab.exCn: FSC要求产销监管链可追溯。

vocab.ex: The emission level is very low.

mistakes.right: Our wood is FSC-certified, E0 grade, with low-VOC paint.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说环保。要给具体认证。

basic.en: We can provide the FSC certificate.

advanced.en: Our rubberwood is FSC-certified with full chain-of-custody traceability, and panels meet E0 formaldehyde levels — well below EN and CARB P2.
advanced.cn: 我们的橡胶木FSC认证，产销监管链完整，板材达E0——远低于EN和CARB P2。

advanced.en: The surface is low-VOC water-based paint, free of heavy metals and formaldehyde, safe for children.
advanced.cn: 表面低VOC水性漆，无重金属无甲醛，儿童安全。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Is your wood FSC certified? We need it for ESG.
lines.cn: 你们木材FSC认证吗？我们ESG报告需要。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Yes, our rubberwood is FSC-certified. Panels are E0 grade with low-VOC paint.
lines.cn: 是的，橡胶木FSC认证。板材E0级，低VOC漆。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Can you send the FSC certificate?

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Of course. I will send the FSC CoC certificate and E0 test report today.
lines.cn: 当然。我今天把FSC CoC证书和E0测试报告发您。

fillBlank.q: E0 is stricter than E1 for ____.
____ VOC paint is better for kids.

scenario.q: A European client asks about wood certification for ESG. Reply.
scenario.modelAnswer: Our rubberwood is FSC-certified with full chain-of-custody. Panels meet E0 formaldehyde standards, and we use low-VOC paint. I can send the FSC CoC certificate and E0 test report today.
scenario.cn: 我们的橡胶木FSC认证，产销监管链完整。板材E0标准，低VOC漆。今天可发FSC CoC证书和E0报告。

culture.title: ESG正在改变外贸
culture.content: 现在欧洲大客户要求供应商提供ESG报告，木材必须FSC。没有FSC，大订单连投标资格都没有。长期看，工厂应该办FSC CoC证书，这是进入大客户供应链的门票。

Can you send the FSC certificate?
Do your panels meet E0 or E1?
